observations.behavior: Adds an additional guard condition to prevent rendering a button when no subscriptions exist.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the behavior of the Subscription management UI; users cannot add a new resource if their account has zero existing subscriptions. This could help avoid empty states or unintended creation attempts in edge cases.

observations.behavior: Updates the label text from "Add subscription" to "Create subscription" while retaining its primary action and click handler.
observations.posthog_connection: Minor copy change, potentially clarifying that this is a provisioning action rather than just adding metadata, though functionally identical for end-users.

observations.behavior: Restricts visibility of the 'Create subscription' button based on whether any subscriptions are present, not just which tab is active.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents showing a create option when there's nothing to manage, possibly reducing confusion or unnecessary clicks by non-admins without relevant permissions or accounts with resources.
